data.title: 中野四叶 · 雨中操场的同伞护送
data.description: 放学后的骤雨让地面泛起白蒙蒙的水汽。四叶撑着一把透明塑料雨伞，毫不犹豫地将大半伞面稳稳遮在少年的头顶。尽管自己的左肩与书包已被雨水完全淋湿，她依然仰起脸露出最温暖的笑容，眼神里只有真切的关切。
data.action: holding umbrella forward, tilting umbrella, wet shoulder, kind smile
data.lighting: soft overcast rain ambiance, reflective wet pavement
data.promptProse: Standing outside the school gate under heavy rain, Nakano Yotsuba holds a clear umbrella, tilting it generously over the viewer. Her left shoulder is soaked by rain, but her face glows with selfless, earnest kindness and a sweet reassuring smile.
data.animaCaption: Yotsuba selflessly sharing her umbrella under the pouring rain.
